name: Rock Vine
tagline: A thick inflexible vine which grows cracked grey bark as hard as stone

name: Sandbox Tree
tagline: A spiky tree with explosive fragmentation nuts

name: Sparkle Berry Bush
tagline: A short bush growing prismatic sparkling red berries

name: Pillow Moss
tagline: A plushy dark green moss as soft as a pillow

name: Leanda's Hair
tagline: A hanging verdant vine looking oddly like the hair of a scholar you know

name: Flash Fungus
tagline: A small purple fungus with glowing pods releasing blue light

name: Cave Webs
tagline: A white sticky lichen with long dread-like strands

name: Filter Fungus
tagline: A giant deep blue-red fungus with a swiss-cheese fruiting body

name: Ember Vine
tagline: A rapidly growing orange vine which releases a sweet-smelling resin

name: Snot Pots
tagline: An orange pitcher plant containing green sticky caustic liquid

name: Goblin Fingers
tagline: A snot-colored vine which grows rapidly towards metallic objects

bio: Trained doctor attached to the Iron Band; the conscience and fault line of the group, sick of patching up grunts who are used as flesh-shields. Vocation: doctor / medic. Carries a medkit and a light sidearm. Gear: medkit, light sidearm.
name: Soren
tagline: The Iron Band's doctor and conscience, sick of patching flesh-shield grunts.

bio: Premise: Rank-and-file mercenaries of the Red Bands company under Captain Mandy, hired to protect the Academy's fungal research unit. They wear armor over the mandated hazmat robes and the company's blood-red armbands. Role: Mercenary guard. Vocation: Mercenary. Gear: spears & bows, armor worn over hazmat robes, blood-red armbands. (Appendix gave no Wounds value; derived 3 from fortitude 4.)
name: Red Band
tagline: Red Bands merc goons in hazmat robes, spears and bows ready.

name: Page
tagline: Page

name: Snotling (Piker)
tagline: Wears bone armor. Wields a short spear.

bio: Inquisitor of the Exiled Chapter, dragged in against her grain — the lever the party can work to crack the Chapter. Vocation: Inquisitor. Gear: greatsword, arbalest, quiver, wound-recovery tattoo (2/combat), might tattoo (1/combat), medium armor.
name: Galedrial
tagline: Inquisitor dragged into the Chapter — the lever.

bio: Rank-and-file grunts of the Exiled Chapter (~7), the rogue church of husk heresy. Gear: 3 javelins, mace, buckler, wound-recovery tattoo (1/combat), light armor, medkit.
name: Exiled Chapter Grunt
tagline: Foot soldier of the husk-heresy church.

aggression: Group-dependent. Will posture and threaten first, only swing if ordered or if outnumbered. Opportunistic strikers.
name: Ruffian
self_preservation: High. Breaks and flees when two of the group are down, or when their employer falls. Self-interest over loyalty.
tactics: Opens from range with javelins, closes with cudgels, daggers as last resort. Targets smallest or most wounded enemy first. Avoids champions and heavy armor.
tagline: Guild-adjacent mercenaries from Riftstone. Mixed gear, mixed discipline. Here for coin, not cause.

name: Jimothy
tagline: Laborer

bio: STUB — parked group, awaits a Channeler design pass before stats are set. The Eternal Chapter is a sanctioned body of Inquisitors and Channelers. They arrive when the fungus goes vertical — climbing toward the anomaly — to restrict the zone and tap the anomaly's power for themselves. This face represents the Chapter's leadership cadre: 2 Inquisitors and 2 Channelers. Faces await the Channeler pass; Reece fleshes out.
name: Eternal Chapter Sensate
tagline: [STUB]

bio: Halfling Artificer apprentice serving as the Black Company's decoy: presented as the artificer while Jack is the true hidden hand. Non-combat — a canary for the outfit. Small. Role: decoy / apprentice / canary. Vocation: Artificer apprentice. Gear: artificer's tools; hand crossbow.
name: Leela
tagline: The decoy artificer — a canary, not a fighter.

bio: Premise: The Sensate official face — the sanctioned public face of the Church at the Ferry Landing hub. One of the four Ferry Landing faction reps, each the sanctioned public face of their faction at the hub. STUB: no stats given in the book; attributes and derived values parked at 0 pending design.
name: Church Rep
role: Ferry Landing faction rep (Church / Sensate official face)
tagline: [STUB]

bio: Premise: The Runite scholarly liaison — the sanctioned public face of the Academy at the Ferry Landing hub. One of the four Ferry Landing faction reps, each the sanctioned public face of their faction at the hub. STUB: no stats given in the book; attributes and derived values parked at 0 pending design.
name: Academy Rep
role: Ferry Landing faction rep (Academy / Runite scholarly liaison)
tagline: [STUB]

bio: Premise: An Elementalist specializing in air — the expedition's Aeromancer. Nervous and high-strung, he maintains an air-bubble spore shield that protects the team from inhaling the fungal cloud. His anxiety is constant; the work terrifies him. Role: Aeromancer / spore-shield support. Vocation: Aeromancer (Elementalist). Gear: hazmat robes (hooded/cowled), hooded lantern, gem jewelry.
name: Jeckil
tagline: The anxious Aeromancer whose air-bubble keeps the spores at bay.

aggression: Immediate on sight of living flesh. No hesitation, no display.
name: Ork Zombie
self_preservation: None. Continues until the body is rendered unusable.
tactics: Nearest living creature with meat on it. Ignores other undead, constructs, and pure-bone remains.
tagline: A dead ork still swinging. Fungal growth crusts the shoulders and skull. Moves with the same heavy gait but slower, clumsier, and it never stops.

bio: A well-trained page attached to the Iron Band. Vocation: page. Gear: page's equipment.
name: Fenn
tagline: A well-trained page riding with the Iron Band.

bio: The Black Company's general crew — a mixed ex-faction rabble held together as a leashed refuge by the prison tattoo, with a firebolt tattoo for offense. Role: company guard / general crew. Gear: prison tattoo; firebolt tattoo; mixed light/medium armor; varied weapons; a gem.
name: Black Guard
tagline: Mixed ex-faction crew, leashed by the prison tattoo, armed with firebolts.

bio: Lead Druid of the Ash Grove Company, a Circle company that culls Amberwood by burning a hex to cultivate a new biome in its place. Sennick is the ends-justify-the-means hand on the torch: the cull is righteous if the grove that follows is greater. Vocation: Druid; skilled in Reagents. Gear: long bow, 4 seed pods, endurance tincture, wound tincture, short spear.
name: Sennick
tagline: Druid lead who burns a hex to seed a new biome — ends justify the means.

aggression: Immediate on sight of living flesh. No hesitation, no display.
name: Mudback Goblin Zombie
self_preservation: None. Continues until the body is rendered unusable.
tactics: Nearest living creature with meat on it. Ignores other undead, constructs, and pure-bone remains.
tagline: A small body dragged back to its feet by fungus. Pale threads web the joints. Still clutches whatever it died holding.

bio: Premise: The faction rep stationed at the Guild Hall — the sanctioned public face of the Guild at the Ferry Landing hub. One of the four Ferry Landing faction reps. NOTE: it is unconfirmed whether the Guild Rep is Walker (who already exists in the bestiary) or a separate NPC. If this turns out to be Walker, do NOT create a duplicate — reference Walker by name instead and discard this stub. STUB: no stats given in the book; attributes and derived values parked at 0 pending design.
name: Guild Rep
role: Ferry Landing faction rep (Guild / at the Guild Hall)
tagline: [STUB]

aggression: Immediate on sight of living flesh. No hesitation, no display.
name: Mycelial Undead
self_preservation: None. Continues until the body is rendered unusable — dismembered, burned, or too broken to carry the fungus.
tactics: Nearest living creature with meat on it. Ignores other undead, constructs, and pure-bone remains.
tagline: A body taken by the fungus. It moves like the creature it used to be, but slower and stranger. A shelf of pale growth crusts along the spine and skull. Tendrils bloom from wounds that should have killed it.

bio: Captain of the Black Company, the foil faction Knot — a 'leashed refuge' whose cohesion is held by Jack's prison tattoo. Artificer-warden and the hidden hand of the outfit: he plays dumb but is sharp and conniving, ex-Academy. Wields heat-exchange tattoos as artificer tools. Role: captain / warden / hidden hand. Vocation: Artificer (ex-Academy). Gear: light armor; concealed sidearm (hand crossbow or short blade); artificer's gem-tattoo tools; heat-exchange tattoos.
name: Captain Jack Black
tagline: The hidden hand of the Black Company — plays dumb, cuts sharp.

bio: STUB / parked face. One of the elders of the Druidic Circle. Premise: tries to prevent a Circle-Guild war and advises the Blood Badger pack, but cannot command it. Needs faces and stats authored later.
name: Circle Elder
tagline: [STUB] A Druidic Circle elder trying to stop a Circle-Guild war.

bio: Six honey-badger berserkers of the Blood Badgers pack (Brock, Dorn, Vesker, Tanny, Turock, Veckna), aligned with the Druidic Circle. Fight in a brew-fueled rage. Vocation: berserker. Gear: javelins, knuckle dusters, cave-sight brew, heal brew, endurance brew, strength brew.
name: Blood Badger
tagline: Honey-badger berserkers who hunt in a trance-fueled pack.

name: Dragonfly (Adult)
tagline: It wasn't chasing you. It was already where you were going.

bio: Premise: Leader of the Red Bands mercenary company contracted to guard the fungal research unit. A hard, capable fighter who wears armor over the mandated hazmat robes and marks her allegiance with the blood-red armband. She keeps the eggheads breathing despite their recklessness. Role: Mercenary captain / security lead. Vocation: Mercenary. Gear: spear, bow, armor worn over hazmat robes, blood-red armband.
name: Captain Mandy
tagline: The Red Bands' captain, hired muscle keeping the reckless scholars alive.

aggression: Hides from groups. Watches. Evaluates. May stalk and ambush an isolated individual to acquire metal armor. This is not hunger — it is desire.
name: Sunstone Ooze
self_preservation: Squeezes through any gap larger than its bezoar. Retreats to its hovel. Seals the chitin door behind it.
tactics: Pseudopod chitin slashes and thrown rocks at range. Grapples to engulf. Inside: localized acid, chitin blades, suffocation. Bezoar is the kill target.
tagline: An amorphous translucent mass the size of a horse. No limbs, no face, no eyes. Pseudopods extend with chitin blades gripped at the tips. A warm amber glow from a sunstone inside.

aggression: Docile when recently fed. Aggressive when hungry. Extremely hostile when molting — attacks anything that enters territory.
name: Rock Shell (Elder)
self_preservation: When not molting: flees into dense brush after 2 wounds. When molting: fights to the death.
tactics: Leads with crushing claw at range, digging claw grab to pin, then crushes pinned target. During molt: charges recklessly.
tagline: Wagon-sized crawdad. Thick segmented shell studded with bone splinters and needles. Two massive asymmetric claws. Carves highways.

bio: Roughly fifteen untrained grunts conscripted into the Iron Band's hunt and used as flesh-shields. Vocation: levy / cannon fodder. Gear: spear, minimal armor, torch staff.
name: Iron Band Grunt
tagline: Untrained levy used as flesh-shields.

aggression: Non-aggressive. Does not fight. Panic leap when spooked is the only danger — incidental slashing from razor scales in the stampede.
name: Mud Skipper
self_preservation: Day: explodes toward nearest pool. Night: burrows into mud. Rain: hunkers down motionless.
tactics: Flees only. Party members in the path of a panicked school take collateral scale damage.
tagline: Broad flat fish the size of a large dog. Dull brown-green. Drags itself on muscular pectoral fins like stubby legs. Scales catch torchlight with a razor glint.

aggression: Males: threat display first, attacks if you don't back off. With chicks: instant maximum aggression. Females: more aggressive, hunts live prey.
name: Axe Crown
self_preservation: Males: flee after 1 wound unless with chicks. Females: flee after 2 wounds. With chicks: never flees.
tactics: Charges with casque ram at full sprint then follows with dagger-claw kicks. Targets legs and torso.
tagline: Large solitary ground bird. Dense dark plumage, bare blue-red skin on neck and head. Tall narrow casque sharpened to a splitting edge. Massive dagger-claw on each inner toe.

aggression: Daytime: ambushes only if something enters the water or lingers at the edge too long. Night: actively hunts on land.
name: Bog Stalker
self_preservation: Flees after 1 wound. Will not defend territory to the death.
tactics: Opens with acid spit at range, then rushes to bite and death roll. Prioritizes targets near water it can drag in.
tagline: Low-slung, broad-jawed, slick-skinned. Crocodile-sized with mottled green-brown hide that disappears in murky water. Stinks of sulfur. Spits.

aggression: Passive until prey approaches the puppet or pool's edge. Then erupts with tentacles.
name: Angler Squid
self_preservation: Never surfaces. Never exposes body. If all tentacles severed, retreats to pool bottom and goes dormant.
tactics: Grab and drag to pool. Once prey is in water, the pool hazard does the killing. Fights through tentacles only.
tagline: Translucent. Nearly invisible in murky water. Body the size of a dog with tentacles 15-20 feet long. Each tentacle has an eye near the tip. Operates a corpse as a puppet.

aggression: Non-aggressive unless brood ball is threatened. If cornered: launches brood ball at threat and flees.
name: Bowling Beetle
self_preservation: Launches ball and runs. Does not fight. Brood is sacrificed, beetle survives.
tactics: One shot — brood ball cannonball — then gone. Multiple beetles may all launch simultaneously before scattering.
tagline: Small beetle with a broad armored head plate and a dark metallic sheen. Pushing a ball the size of a curled Moss Roller. Disproportionately strong for its size.

bio: Lead of the Iron Band, Walker's Hall hunting party. A hulking sellsword and true believer in the cause, Humble fronts the elite mercs and the mass of grunts. Wields an oversized arbalest. Vocation: sellsword / hunt-lead. Gear: oversized arbalest, bodkin bolts, fine full brigandine, bullseye lantern.
name: Humble
tagline: The true-believer hulk who leads the Iron Band's hunt.

aggression: Passive until prey pushes through the vine wall. Contact triggered — not a decision.
name: Oasis Maw
self_preservation: Cannot flee. Sessile. Must be killed or avoided. Destroying the central pitcher kills the organism.
tactics: Grab and drag toward central pitcher at 1m per round. Slow but does not release. Can grab up to 4 targets simultaneously.
tagline: You don't see this creature. You see weeping vines. You push through them to reach the water and some of the vines don't let go.

aggression: None. Completely non-aggressive. Does not fight.
name: Moly Poly
self_preservation: Curls into armored ball. Can remain curled for hours. Defense jumps to 6, immune to Slashing while curled.
tactics: N/A. Curls and waits. When one curls, nearby curl too — creates field of armored boulders as difficult terrain.
tagline: Dog-sized armored isopod. Pale gray-brown segmented shell. Dozens of short legs, steady trundling gait. Rolls into a waist-high armored boulder when threatened.

bio: Premise: The official druid liaison — the sanctioned public face of the Circle at the Ferry Landing hub. One of the four Ferry Landing faction reps, each the sanctioned public face of their faction at the hub. STUB: no stats given in the book; attributes and derived values parked at 0 pending design.
name: Circle Rep
role: Ferry Landing faction rep (Circle / druid liaison)
tagline: [STUB]

bio: Tree ranger of the Ash Grove Company and its camp-mom canary — the conscience of the cull. She grew the sandbox town. Vocation: Ranger (tree); skilled in Engineering. Gear: long bow, 4 seed pods, endurance tincture, wound tincture, short spear.
name: Eska
tagline: Tree ranger and camp-mom canary — grew the sandbox town.

bio: Premise: The revenant who haunts the collapsed tower. Regal, scholarly, and centuries old — a self-mummifying revenant, missing an arm, robed head-to-toe. He keeps an archive-hoard in which every item carries a trap rune (a self-defending hoard). He is hunted by the Silvans. He sends the party to retrieve the Nek'ra soul-vessel sphere — the quest hook that opens the relationship. Stance: ally-of-convenience first, a future standalone antagonist later. Recommended stats per the book: powerful overall; frail in Fortitude but formidable in Intellect/Intuition/Willpower, the product of centuries of preservation and binding magic. Self-defending hoard / does not leave: Rathos does not leave the tower; his power is bound to the archive, whose every trap-runed item defends the hoard. No catalogable carried gear.
name: Rathos
tagline: The regal, centuries-old revenant of the collapsed tower — an ally of convenience first, a future antagonist after.

bio: STUB — parked group, awaits a Channeler design pass before stats are set. Rank-and-file soldiers of the Eternal Chapter who escort the Inquisitors and Channelers in to lock down the anomaly zone once the fungus goes vertical. The Chapter restricts the area and taps the anomaly's power. Reece fleshes out.
name: Eternal Chapter Grunt
tagline: [STUB]

bio: Inquisitor of the Exiled Chapter — the husker and hoarder who grafts the plant-husks but barely fights himself. Vocation: Inquisitor (husker). Gear: greatsword, arbalest, quiver, wound-recovery tattoo (2/combat), might tattoo (1/combat), medium armor.
name: Palen
tagline: Inquisitor husker and hoarder who barely fights.

name: Guild Apprentice
tagline: Academy note-takers documenting the fungal anomaly at close, dangerous range.

aggression: Territorial. Charges unfamiliar creatures on sight within its tunnel network or pool territory.
name: Rock Shell (Adult)
self_preservation: Flees into dense brush or tunnels after 2 wounds if not defending territory. During molting: fights to the death.
tactics: Leads with crushing claw at range, digging claw grab to pin, then crushes pinned target. Tail fan slap clears rear threats.
tagline: Chest-high and long as a cart. Heavy segmented shell crusted with splinter pod spines. Digging claw broad as a table, crushing claw can fold a shield.

aggression: Docile unless attacked, too close to cubs, holding fish caps.
name: Stinky
self_preservation: 2 injuries = flees, Cubs present = Fight to death, Fish caps on player = fights until 4 injuries
tactics: attacks biggest target first or target dealing slashing damage
tagline: A massive nearly elephant-sized creature with thick matted fur. Long neck, massive maw adorned with two tusks akin to large spearheads. Long tail holds a stone-like keratin mace bigger than your head

bio: Arborist grunts of the Keethee — Small goblins sharing one telepathic identity, each riding a gimler mount. Gear: 3 javelins, 2 hand axes, light armor, gimler mount, 1 rage tincture, 1 hemotoxic oil.
name: Keethee Arborist
tagline: Gimler-mounted arborist goblin of the shared Keethee mind.

aggression: Highly aggressive. Attacks anything within leap range. Far more dangerous than its size suggests — does not bluff.
name: Crushers / Giant Frog
self_preservation: Flees after 2 wounds. If guarding eggs: fights to the death.
tactics: Opens with crushing leap, follows with tongue grapple to swallow. Targets Medium or smaller prey for swallowing. Attacks biggest visible threat otherwise.
tagline: Bigger than a grizzly bear. Orange and green skin covered in weeping boils. Mouth wide enough to swallow a person. Sits unnervingly still.

name: Dragonfly
tagline: It wasn't chasing you. It was already where you were going.

aggression: Docile unless nest is approached. Within nest radius: fight to the death.
name: Rot Hornets
self_preservation: None. The swarm protects the nest. Individual hornets are expendable.
tactics: Swarms the closest target to the nest. Cannot be targeted individually — AOE attacks bypass defense.
tagline: Angry black hornets swarming from hollowed rotten logs. The air around the nest smells like rotting flesh.

name: Dragonfly (Hatchling Swarm)
tagline: The water moves wrong.

aggression: Targets stationary or sleeping prey specifically. Moving steadily deters it. Stopping invites it.
name: Stalker Bat
self_preservation: Flees after 1 wound.
tactics: Latch, suck, drain passively. Dodge if attacked. Does not fight — feeds.
tagline: Eagle-sized bat with dark fur that vanishes against the night canopy. Silent in flight. You don't see it — you feel lightheaded and find the puncture wounds later.

aggression: Ambush predator. Strikes anything within 2m of the water surface that produces vibration. Will not pursue onto land.
name: Dragonfly (Nymph)
self_preservation: Missed strike = immediate Submerge. 1 wound = dead. Exception: during pulse transitions, does not flee on miss.
tactics: Strikes nearest vibration source. No target prioritization — reacts to movement, not threat.
tagline: Something moved beneath the boat.

aggression: Ambushes anything within striking distance. Attacks as a group — multiple simultaneous bites.
name: Moss Python
self_preservation: Flees if one of the group dies.
tactics: Multiple bites to stack torpor venom. Doesn't pursue — waits for prey to collapse then feeds.
tagline: Forearm-length snakes draped on branches and roots. Moss-green coloring. Indistinguishable from hanging moss until they move. Travel in groups of 3-6.

name: Dragonfly (Emergent)
tagline: A split husk at the waterline, still wet.

aggression: Gently herds target out of ruins. If players aggress, attacks until they leave.
name: Sentry
tagline: Brown Lichen covering stone body. Smallest golem at 7ft tall. Cudgels built into arms.

name: Dragonfly (Juvenile Swarm)
tagline: Don't trail your hands.

aggression: Docile unless attacked, too close to cubs, holding fish caps.
name: Cattlepos
self_preservation: 2 injuries = flees, Cubs present = Fight to death, Fish caps on player = fights until 4 injuries
tactics: attacks biggest target first or target dealing slashing damage
tagline: A massive nearly elephant-sized creature with thick matted fur. Long neck, massive maw adorned with two tusks akin to large spearheads. Long tail holds a stone-like keratin mace bigger than your head

bio: Thicc hobbit representative and democratic leader of Fletcher's Co-op, here to harvest vole-iron while keeping the apex alive. Vocation: co-op representative. Gear: custom crossbow (fires twice before reload), specialized bodkin-tip bolts, dimmable lantern, well-crafted armor.
name: Terry
tagline: The thicc hobbit rep who runs Fletcher's Co-op by vote.

aggression: Actively hunts in packs. Surrounds targets while cackling. Goes for isolated or weakened prey. Will try to drag downed targets away.
name: Cackler
self_preservation: Flees when a few of the pack die. Will not flee if defending the nest or if Matriarch is directing the hunt.
tactics: Herds targets toward Matriarch if present. Surrounds and isolates weakest or most injured target. Drags downed targets away from the group.
tagline: Dog-sized, matted dark fur, stinks of rot. Four limbs each ending in grasping hands with thumbs instead of paws. Heavy jaw built wider than the skull.

aggression: Drops rocks on anything passing below their canopy. Fights to the death if you climb into their trees.
name: Howlers
self_preservation: Flees when a few die — unless you're in the canopy. On their turf they don't back down.
tactics: Rock bombardment from above. If target climbs up, switches to claw attacks. Targets the climber specifically.
tagline: Small marsupial with a belly pouch and grasping hands. Dark fur. Lives exclusively in the canopy. Carries rocks in its pouch. Loud territorial calls during daylight.

name: Snotling
tagline: Wears bone armor. Wields a short spear.

aggression: Goes after the biggest target. Extremely aggressive when young are nearby.
name: Cackler matriarch
script: Stays near the nest in the Undergrove guarding young. Males bring food. Occasionally joins coordinated hunts as the ambush anchor. Silent in the nest at night. Does not emerge when the Anaconda is active.
self_preservation: Only flees if a giant anaconda is present. Otherwise fights until dead.
tactics: Targets the largest creature. Waits for males to herd prey to her, then charges with Body Slam to knock targets prone before delivering Crushing Maw bites. Anchors the ambush; does not chase.
tagline: Horse-sized pack heart. Bone-crusher. Will not flee unless an Anaconda is present.

aggression: Active predator. Detects prey by heat signature through open air and charges. Territorial.
name: Mole Cricket
self_preservation: Flees after 2 wounds unless cornered or guarding eggs.
tactics: Charges at speed through existing passages. Uses body to block retreat in tight tunnels while attacking with mandibles and shovel-claws.
tagline: Wolf-sized armored cricket. Broad shovel-claws for forelimbs. Cylindrical velvety body. In the dark you hear heavy chitinous legs sprinting toward you.

name: Snotling (Archer)
tagline: Wears camouflage. Wields a bow.

aggression: Always hunting. High metabolism means starvation is hours away. There is no passive state.
name: Bore Weasels (Swarm)
self_preservation: Flee at ~50% swarm casualties. That's 10-25 dead weasels.
tactics: Swarm from all directions — bore holes above, tunnels below, branches around. Nip, retreat, nip. Hamstring to cripple fleeing prey.
tagline: Rat-sized weasels with dull brown-black fur. Long sinuous bodies that pour through holes like water. Dozens of them, flowing out of bore holes from every direction.

name: Grackle
tagline: Page

aggression: Flees first. Fights only when cornered or protecting young. Males will charge if you get between them and the group.
name: Verdant Goats
self_preservation: Runs at speed 10 when spooked. Flees after 1 wound. Will not stay and fight if escape is possible.
tactics: Horn charge to create distance, then flees. Does not pursue. Defensive only.
tagline: Horse-sized goat with thick fur patterned to match the local foliage. Large curved horns. Travels in family groups. Eats everything — plants, bugs, corpses, bones.

aggression: Ambushes from camouflage. Kicks up dust to obscure vision then strikes with proboscis.
name: Trunk Devil
self_preservation: Flees after 2 wounds. Fast — speed 5.
tactics: Kicks up dust cloud first, then drains with proboscis while target is blinded. Prioritizes isolated targets.
tagline: Tall, spindly, bark-textured legs like tree trunks. Long mosquito-like proboscis. Crouches among the trees and looks like one until it moves.

aggression: Hunts actively. Will attack threats to the settlement without hesitation. Calm and patient when not hunting.
name: Gimler (Adult)
self_preservation: Will not flee if carrying a rider. Riderless, retreats after 2 wounds by climbing out of reach.
tactics: Drops from above, beak first. Pins target with talons, drives beak in, tongue liquefies internals. With a rider, makes strafing passes using short hover bursts.
tagline: Tall as a human at the shoulder, most of that height in the legs. Shaggy grist hair hangs in long stretchy strands. Gnarl pike beak is forearm-length and wickedly sharp.

aggression: Hunts anything Big or larger. Ignores Small and smaller. Medium is opportunistic.
name: Cattlepos-Eating Anaconda
self_preservation: Retreats if seriously injured. Rarely fights anything that fights back effectively — prefers constriction kills on unaware prey.
tactics: Ambush constriction. Drops from canopy or strikes from undergrowth. Wraps and squeezes. Does not release until prey stops struggling.
tagline: Longer than a fallen tree. Thick as a barrel. Dark mottled scales. When this thing moves at night, everything else in the forest goes silent.

name: Snotling (Stalker)
tagline: Wears dark clothing with hood. Wields two daggers.

bio: Premise: A small burrowing rodent and the foundation of the co-op's iron economy. It chews roots, separates iron in its gut, and grows that iron into quills — pure iron, sharp, and rusty — borne on its back. The harvest of these quills is the iron supply the co-op depends on. Role: prey / harvestable wildlife. Ecology warning: left unchecked the species would destroy the ecosystem, so its population is managed. Natural armor: the iron quills give it Defense 2. No gear.
name: Quilled Vole
tagline: Root-chewing prey whose gut spins raw iron into rusty quills — the co-op's living iron harvest.

aggression: Passive — the slime is the trap, not the eels. Triggered by falling or stepping into a slime-overtaken pool.
name: Slime Eels
self_preservation: N/A — environmental hazard.
tactics: Cannot swim in mucosal slime — no buoyancy, you sink. 2 Endurance per turn. Eels don't bite — drowning is the kill mechanism.
tagline: The water's surface has a thick opalescent sheen. It doesn't ripple in the wind. You cannot swim in this. You sink.

aggression: Gently herds target out of ruins. If players aggress, attacks until they leave.
name: Decrepit Lichen Sentry
tagline: Brown Lichen covering stone body. Smallest golem at 7ft tall. Cudgels built into arms.

aggression: Entering or approaching an infested pool. Larger detection radius than Lily Snatchers.
name: Lily Snatcher (Blood)
self_preservation: N/A — stationary plant.
tactics: Multiple tendrils grab simultaneously. Pulls targets underwater. Drowning is the kill mechanism.
tagline: Mature Lily Snatchers. Thicker tendrils, stronger grip. Some pools are so overgrown the entire water surface is unsafe. The root hearts have significant healing properties.

aggression: Gently herds target out of ruins. If players aggress, attacks until they leave.
name: Decrepit Lichen Sentry (Warden)
tagline: 8ft tall stone golem with massive shield arm. Brown lichen covering stone body. Highest defense of the golems.

aggression: Violently threatens with spear until creature leaves or retaliates. Then tries to kill until creature leaves or dies.
name: Decrepit Lichen Sentry (Sentinel)
tagline: Largest golem in the tower at 10ft tall. Lichen glows orange. Wields massive poleaxe. If fire damage is dealt, becomes enflamed — napalm-like substance deals heat damage to anyone in range.

aggression: Follows vibration. Every footstep is a signal. Does not decide to hunt — it follows stimulus. Mindless persistence.
name: Skitter Worm
self_preservation: None. Cannot be intimidated, reasoned with, or frightened. Must be killed or escaped. Returns underground at dawn.
tactics: Flows toward nearest vibration and overruns. Circles back if prey still moving. Coils around motionless targets. Progressive paralysis venom.
tagline: A centipede as long as a tall human and thick as a thigh. Dark wet chitinous sheen. Dozens of hooked legs. Front legs modified into venomous pincers the size of short swords.

aggression: Defends herd aggressively. Charges at leg height between trees. Fights to death if calves are present.
name: Loggerhead
self_preservation: Flees after 2 wounds unless calves present. Retreats into dense undergrowth.
tactics: Charge, retreat, charge again. Herd forms shoulder-to-shoulder wall between trees. Targets legs — knocking prone in the Amberwood is a cascading disaster.
tagline: Thigh-high barrel-bodied animal, as wide as it is tall. Dome-shaped skull like a battering ram. Heavy beaver-like front teeth. Dark coarse fur matted with bark dust and resin.

aggression: None. Purely contact-triggered. Does not choose to attack. If you don't touch it, it can't hurt you.
name: Canopy Clutch
self_preservation: Cannot flee. Sessile. Cutting creates two colonies. Must be destroyed comprehensively.
tactics: Grab, lockjaw curl toxin, retract upward, feeding mat wraps and digests. No active targeting.
tagline: Looks exactly like Leanda's Hair hanging from the canopy. Pale translucent threads draped between branches. Until you grab one and your fist locks shut around it.

aggression: Automatic on contact when wading or falling into infested water. No attack roll.
name: Blood Worms
self_preservation: N/A — parasitic, no combat behavior.
tactics: Drains 1 Endurance immediately, then 1 per minute. Engorged after 5+ minutes. Pulling off causes 1d4 Bleed per worm.
tagline: Pale wormy things latching onto your legs the moment you wade in. You feel them attach. By the time you look down there are three.

aggression: Stepping on lily pads or wading near them in infested pools.
name: Lily Snatcher
self_preservation: N/A — stationary plant.
tactics: Tendrils wrap ankles and pull downward. 1 Endurance per turn while submerged. Drowning is the kill mechanism. Dead victims become bait for scavengers.
tagline: Lily pads with tendrils underneath. Something grabs your ankle and rolls shut around it, pulling you under. The juvenile phase — a successful kill matures it into a Blood Snatcher.

aggression: Does not attack conventionally. Excretes toxic adhesive glue that immobilizes prey. Converges on stuck targets to digest via proboscis.
name: Trunk Devil (Larva)
self_preservation: Individual grubs are fragile. Colony relies on the glue doing the work. Fire destroys them but risks dust explosion.
tactics: Immobilize through adhesive, converge, insert proboscis, inject digestive acid, liquefy insides, drink.
tagline: Forearm-sized grubs burrowed into amber fir bark. Indistinguishable from resin heads when curled on the trunk. The ground around infested trees is sticky.

bio: The biggest and strongest of the Blood Badgers honey-badger berserker pack, aligned with the Druidic Circle. Talked the pack into killing the guilders. Drinks an elixir that grants +1 wound slot while in trance (situational; base stored). Vocation: berserker / pack-strongest. Uses reagents. Gear: javelins, knuckle dusters, cave-sight brew, heal brew, endurance brew, strength brew, trance elixir (+1 wound slot).
name: Skar
tagline: The biggest Blood Badger, who talked the pack into killing the guilders.

aggression: Defensive — attacks only if the swarm or their food source is approached.
name: Pygmy Hog (Swarm)
self_preservation: Flees when morale breaks. Scatters in all directions into the thicket.
tactics: Walls of tusks and hooves. Holds ground around the food.
tagline: A massive feeding herd acting as one aggressive body. Hundreds of bristly hogs packed shoulder to shoulder, tusks out.

bio: A mycelial undead engine and the primary source of undead in the Knot. The Heilmind colonizes flesh, threading dead bodies with fungal growth and animating them. Its flower-field bloom spreads and climbs ever upward toward the anomaly, drawing power from it as it grows vertical. The central organism behind the Fungal Anomaly's undead infestation. STUB stats — modest defaults set; Reece fleshes out endurance/wounds/abilities.
name: Heilmind
tagline: The mycelial engine of the dead — colonized flesh blooming a flower-field that climbs toward the anomaly.

bio: Vine ranger of the Ash Grove Company. Briar is loyal to a fault — follows Sennick's cull without question. Vocation: Ranger (vine). Gear: long bow, 4 seed pods, endurance tincture, wound tincture, short spear.
name: Briar
tagline: Vine ranger, loyal to a fault.

aggression: Protective of bonded goblin and younger Onos. Challenges unfamiliar creatures entering the tunnels.
name: Onos (Adolescent)
self_preservation: Will not flee if bonded goblin or younger Onos are present. Otherwise retreats to a narrow tunnel after 2 wounds.
tactics: Crown forward, blocks passage. Acid spray to soften targets, then rams. Positions itself between threat and whatever it's protecting.
tagline: Waist-high and wide as a barrel. The gnarl crown has thickened into a proper shield face. Tongue reaches further now, leaving acid-smoothed streaks across walls.

bio: Arborist shaman and the face of the Keethee, the arborist goblins who share one telepathic identity. She rides an elder gimler mount and wields both telekinesis and telepathy. Small. Gear: light armor, telekinesis, telepathy, elder gimler mount.
name: Keethee
tagline: Arborist shaman of the Keethee — telekinesis and telepathy, riding an elder gimler.

aggression: Calm and deliberate. Will block a passage and hold position rather than chase. Extremely aggressive if the spawning pool is threatened.
name: Onos
self_preservation: Will not flee. If overwhelmed, backs into the nearest chokepoint and seals it with its crown.
tactics: Plants itself and becomes a wall. Acid spray at approaching targets, rams anything that gets close. Stomps to clear groups.
tagline: Broad as a cart and built like a living barricade. The gnarl crown spans wider than its body, edges thick with mineral accretion. Heavy gnarl plates cover the back and flanks.

aggression: Group-dependent. Will posture and threaten first, only swing if ordered or if outnumbered. Opportunistic strikers.
name: Human
self_preservation: High. Breaks and flees when two of the group are down, or when their employer falls. Self-interest over loyalty.
tactics: Opens from range with javelins, closes with cudgels, daggers as last resort. Targets smallest or most wounded enemy first. Avoids champions and heavy armor.
tagline: Guild-adjacent mercenaries from Riftstone. Mixed gear, mixed discipline. Here for coin, not cause.

aggression: Will not attack unless its bonded goblin or poolmates are threatened. Hisses and flares tongue as warning.
name: Onos (Young)
self_preservation: Flees toward the nearest tunnel too small for pursuers. If poolmates are at risk, fights to the death.
tactics: Faces threats head-on, crown forward. Acid spray at range, rams to topple.
tagline: A stocky low-slung creature no bigger than a dog. Thick stubby legs, flat gnarl-plated face, a tubular tongue that flicks out to taste stone.

aggression: Skittish. Flees from anything larger than itself. Will peck aggressively if cornered or if its bonded goblin is hurt.
name: Gimler (Young)
self_preservation: Runs vertically up the nearest trunk and disappears into the canopy. Extremely difficult to catch.
tactics: Pecks and retreats. Too small for tongue attacks — beak only.
tagline: A spindly thing barely the size of a squirrel. Long legs with tiny hooked talons grip bark effortlessly. Stringy grist hair. Gnarl pike beak sharp but barely longer than a finger.

aggression: Hunts small prey independently. Defensive of its bonded goblin. Hisses and spreads grist hair as threat display.
name: Gimler (Adolescent)
self_preservation: Climbs out of reach after 1 wound. If bonded goblin is present, holds ground longer.
tactics: Strikes from above — drops onto prey, beak first, then climbs away. Beginning to use tongue on small kills.
tagline: Dog-sized with disproportionately long legs. Grist hair thickening into shaggy coverage. Gnarl pike beak now a serious weapon — a handspan long, hard, and sharp.

aggression: Does not attack unless the spawning pool or tribe is under direct threat. When it does, it is committed and does not stop.
name: Onos (Elder)
self_preservation: None. Will die in place before abandoning its post.
tactics: Immovable wall. Acid spray to melt approaching threats. Rams with catastrophic force. Stomps to collapse footing.
tagline: Fills a large chamber doorway crown-edge to crown-edge. The gnarl crown is a solid wall of mineral-dense plating, some specimens over two feet thick at the center.

bio: Lead of the Exiled Chapter, a rogue church preaching husk heresy and fielding plant-grafted husks. Mordant is a Sensate who wields both arts. Vocation: Sensate; skilled in Soul Force. Gear: greatsword, arbalest, quiver, wound-recovery tattoo (2/combat), might tattoo (1/combat), medium armor.
name: Mordant
tagline: Sensate lead of the Exiled Chapter — husk heresy, both arts.

name: Oldin
role: Expedition leader, Cattlepos hunter, prisoner awaiting trial. Weapon Skill 6.
tagline: Black Company. Claymore and full plate. Buffs his squad, and more so in formation.

aggression: Chooses its moments. Will sit motionless for hours and then strike with no warning. Extremely aggressive in defense of the settlement or young Gimlers.
name: Gimler (Elder)
self_preservation: Does not flee. If badly wounded, climbs to the highest point available and perches.
tactics: Precision strikes from above. Beak punches through armor. Tongue liquefies and drains in seconds. Can pin Big creatures. Devastating dive attacks from height.
tagline: Taller than a horse and lean as a spear. Gnarl pike beak could skewer a human through the chest. Grist hair hangs in long heavy curtains, matted with age.

aggression: Skittish. Burrows away from anything larger than itself. Snaps claws as warning if cornered.
name: Rock Shell (Young)
self_preservation: Digs straight down and vanishes. Extremely fast underground at this size.
tactics: Pinches and retreats. Tail fan slap if grabbed from behind.
tagline: Cat-sized crawdad. Segmented gnarl shell, six stubby legs, two small asymmetric claws. Scuttles fast, digs constantly, disappears into soil in seconds.

name: Walker
role: Guild master craftsman, cart designer, wheelchair-bound, only wilderness vehicle engineer in Rift Stone

name: Carni Batkin (Blunderbuss)
tagline: Flight 10 m · walk 6 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. 4d6 shrapnel in a 20 m cone.

name: Carni Batkin (Long Spear)
tagline: Flight 10 m · walk 6 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Partisan, 4 m reach.

name: Carni Batkin (Tank)
tagline: Flight 10 m · walk 6 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Tower shield.

name: Fishing Batkin (Anti-air)
tagline: Flight 15 m level, 20 m diving · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Two-handed hammer, +1 m reach.

name: Fishing Batkin (Bomber)
tagline: Flight 15 m level, 20 m diving · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Grenades — a dropped bomb is not halved.

name: Fishing Batkin (Dropper)
tagline: Flight 15 m level, 20 m diving · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Drops rocks.

name: Fishing Batkin (Sniper)
tagline: Flight 15 m level, 20 m diving · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Long bow.

name: Fruit Batkin (Battle)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Claws, bite and a mounted gun. Carries four.

name: Fruit Batkin (Carrier)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Claws and bite. Carries six.

name: Insectivore Batkin (Commander)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Buffs retinue members within 15 m.

name: Insectivore Batkin (Rifle)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Matchlock musket.

name: Insectivore Batkin (Slinger)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Sling.

name: Insectivore Batkin (Spear & Buckler)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Short spear and buckler.

name: Tent-maker Batkin (Artillery)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. 3d6 force in a 2 m radius at 300 m.

name: Tent-maker Batkin (Mounted Gun)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Mounted gun — 2 AP to fire, 2 to reload.

name: Tent-maker Batkin (Trap Ambusher)
tagline: Flight 10 m · crawl 3 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Buries bomb traps — detection rating 3.

name: Vampiric Batkin (Assassin)
tagline: Flight 10 m · walk 6 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Dagger, and it drinks.

name: Vampiric Batkin (Grappler)
tagline: Flight 10 m · walk 6 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Net, and it drinks.

name: Vampiric Batkin (Thrower)
tagline: Flight 10 m · walk 6 m · 4 endurance per turn airborne. Throwing knives, and it drinks.

bio: The Iron Band's four elite mercenaries (Bloke, Jenna, Kyle, Jim). Trained professional fighters carrying arbalests and bodkin bolts in fine full brigandine, with bullseye lanterns. Vocation: mercenary. Gear: arbalest, bodkin bolts, fine full brigandine, bullseye lantern.
name: Guild Mercenary
tagline: Elite professional muscle of the Iron Band.

aggression: Hunts actively. Will attack threats to the settlement without hesitation. Calm and patient when not hunting.
name: Gimler
self_preservation: Will not flee if carrying a rider. Riderless, retreats after 2 wounds by climbing out of reach.
tactics: Drops from above, beak first. Pins target with talons, drives beak in, tongue liquefies internals. With a rider, makes strafing passes using short hover bursts.
tagline: Tall as a human at the shoulder, most of that height in the legs. Shaggy grist hair hangs in long stretchy strands. Gnarl pike beak is forearm-length and wickedly sharp.

name: Black Company Crossbowman
tagline: Light crossbow, and the drill to reload it inside one action.

name: Newt
tagline: Company medic. A dagger he does not want to use. Keeps the dying from dying.

name: Black Company Pikeman
tagline: Partisan and nothing else. One wound and he is out of the fight.

aggression: Attacks as a group when threatened. Individually cowardly — only brave in numbers.
name: Pygmy Hog
self_preservation: Flees when 1-4 of the herd die depending on herd size.
tactics: Swarms the nearest threat. Rams with tusks. Breaks and scatters if enough die.
tagline: Knee-high hogs in packs of a dozen or more. Bristly brown fur, sharp little tusks. Constantly rooting at the ground.

bio: A squad of twelve hobbits running the vole-iron harvest for Fletcher's Co-op. Disciplined and well-equipped. Vocation: co-op harvester. Gear: custom crossbow (fires twice before reload), specialized bodkin-tip bolts, dimmable lantern, well-crafted armor.
name: Fletcher's Co-op Squad
tagline: Disciplined hobbit harvesters with twice-firing crossbows.

name: Val
role: Goblinoid trance specialist, defector from Druidic Circle, killed at Ironwood Hovel

bio: Premise: The expedition's record-keepers (Quinn, Timmy, Tolsa) — they transcribe Silfrena's findings, sketch the growth, and seal samples in their canisters. Soft scholars pressed into the field. Role: Field scribe / support. Vocation: Scribe. Gear: hand crossbow, hooded lantern, satchel, scribe's canister, hazmat robes (hooded/cowled) + gem jewelry.
name: Scribe
tagline: Academy note-takers documenting the fungal anomaly at close, dangerous range.

aggression: Opportunistic. Dive-bites anything small enough to eat. Ignores larger creatures.
name: Quetzalittle
self_preservation: Flees with a single wound. Extremely evasive in the air.
tactics: Dive bite and return to air. Does not engage on the ground.
tagline: Small flying reptiles with iridescent scales. Vary in size — most are cat-sized, rare specimens grow as large as a short bus. Only seen during daylight.

name: [Inquisitor — Needs Name]
role: Sensate investigator, commands husks, dispatched to Ironwood Hovel

aggression: Territorial over its current tunnel section. Charges unfamiliar creatures that enter.
name: Rock Shell (Adolescent)
self_preservation: Retreats backward through its own tunnel using tail-jet. If cornered, fights aggressively.
tactics: Digging claw grab to pin, crushing claw to finish. Tail fan compaction slap at rear threats.
tagline: Knee-high and long as a dog. Shell hardening, splinter pod fragments embedding in carapace. Asymmetric claws clearly differentiated.

name: Donny
role: Ruffian who spoke up against Oldin. Struck down by his employer. His death broke the crew.

aggression: Territorial. Charges unfamiliar creatures on sight within its tunnel network or pool territory.
name: Rock Shell
self_preservation: Flees into dense brush or tunnels after 2 wounds if not defending territory. During molting: fights to the death.
tactics: Leads with crushing claw at range, digging claw grab to pin, then crushes pinned target. Tail fan slap clears rear threats.
tagline: Chest-high and long as a cart. Heavy segmented shell crusted with splinter pod spines. Digging claw broad as a table, crushing claw can fold a shield.

bio: Lieutenant of Fletcher's Co-op who wants to protect the apex creature during the vole-iron harvest. Vocation: co-op lieutenant. Gear: custom crossbow (fires twice before reload), specialized bodkin-tip bolts, dimmable lantern, well-crafted armor.
name: Columbo
tagline: Fletcher's lieutenant determined to protect the apex.

bio: Premise: An Elementalist specializing in earth — the expedition's Geomancer. He shapes stone into the research station's platform and the walkways the team uses to navigate above the fungal field. Steadiest of the casters. Role: Structural elementalist / terrain-shaper. Vocation: Geomancer (Elementalist). Gear: hazmat robes (hooded/cowled), hooded lantern, heavy gem jewelry.
name: Dalenar
tagline: The Geomancer who raises the research structure and walkways from the earth itself.

name: Guild Merc
tagline: Elite professional muscle of the Iron Band.

bio: Premise: Head of the Academy/Runite fungal-ecology research expedition. A Lector (scholar-mage) who is strictly non-combat — she directs, records, and theorizes while others do the dangerous work. Reckless in her drive to study the anomaly. Role: Expedition head / non-combat scholar. Vocation: Lector. Gear: hand crossbow, hooded lantern, satchel, scribe's canister, hazmat robes (hooded/cowled) + gem jewelry.
name: Silfrena
tagline: The Lector who leads the expedition and would never dirty her hands with combat.

aggression: Calm and deliberate. Will block a passage and hold position rather than chase. Extremely aggressive if the spawning pool is threatened.
name: Onos (Adult)
self_preservation: Will not flee. If overwhelmed, backs into the nearest chokepoint and seals it with its crown.
tactics: Plants itself and becomes a wall. Acid spray at approaching targets, rams anything that gets close. Stomps to clear groups.
tagline: Broad as a cart and built like a living barricade. The gnarl crown spans wider than its body, edges thick with mineral accretion. Heavy gnarl plates cover the back and flanks.

bio: Rank-and-file grunts of the Ash Grove Company (20+), the Circle company burning a hex to cultivate a new biome. Gear: 2 seed pods, short bow, quiver, light armor, endurance tincture, short spear, medkit.
name: Ash Grove Grunt
tagline: Rank-and-file Circle hand on the Amberwood cull.

bio: Second lieutenant of the Black Company. A loyal-to-a-fault sociopath: athletic and agile in melee. Bound by the prison tattoo like the rest of the leashed refuge, and carries a heat-siphon tattoo. Role: second lieutenant / enforcer. Gear: prison tattoo; heat-siphon tattoo; medium armor; agile melee (blade or spear).
name: Amos
tagline: Loyal-to-a-fault sociopath — athletic, agile, and leashed.

name: Ork (Berserker)
tagline: Hammer and axe.

name: Ork (Pack Leader)
tagline: Long sword and warhammer, and a third swing.

name: Ork (Piker)
tagline: Long spear and buckler.

name: Ork (Pyromancer)
tagline: Firebolt, Fire Blast and a Fire Whip.

name: Ork (Skirmisher)
tagline: Blade and shield.

name: Ork (Sniper)
tagline: Long bow.

name: Warg
tagline: Quadruped. Blood Nostril. Carries one rider.
